description.txt: No company, no setup, in every browser + OS. A device-held keypair = a self-sovereign identity. Verified in-core with pure-Rust p256/ed25519-dalek (ES256/EdDSA). The cemented not-big-tech default.
Bring-your-own-key: a portable, cross-app self-sovereign secp256k1 identity via a browser extension. Verified pure-Rust via k256. For when cross-app portability matters.
Only for real-account gating. Public client_id (safe to commit), NO secret, NO server. ID token verified offline against Google JWKS.
Signed by a ROOT key. Binds a role (e.g. board:X writer) to the user identity keypair. Offline-verifiable, attenuable, delegatable.
